headline: Revenue and profit growth accelerate as leverage climbs
summary_short: Nexstar's Q1 FY2026 revenue rose 13.1% y/y to $1,396M and net income grew 51.9% y/y to $164M, while long-term debt nearly doubled to $12,152M following the quarter's financing activity.
summary_long: Q1 FY2026 revenue was $1,396M, up 13.1% y/y and 8.3% q/q. EBITDA reached $466M (+5.9% y/y). Net income of $164M swung from a $166M q/q loss and rose 51.9% y/y; diluted EPS was $5.09 versus $3.37 a year earlier. Operating cash flow fell 14.2% y/y to $289M as capex declined 37.1% y/y to $22M. Cash grew 49.8% y/y to $379M. Long-term debt jumped 87.1% y/y and 91.9% q/q to $12,152M, with short-term debt up 121.0% y/y to $274M.
